result.topic_en: Observation log of timed readings with their logarithms and group means for an open circuit (temperature noted), followed by a recapitulation table in which interpolated open-circuit values are subtracted from closed-circuit values and the differences are averaged.

methods.what: Common (base-10) logarithms of the scale readings, e.g. log 380.5 = 2.58035
Arithmetic mean of the logarithms over each group of five readings
Linear interpolation of an alternating series: the mean of the adjacent values of one state is subtracted from the intermediate value of the other state
Arithmetic mean of the five closed-minus-open differences
